meta.title: Archive Favorites Forge
meta.description: Favourite DSH conversations, copy session id + transcript path, delete one permanently, batch-archive idle ones, filter the sidebar to favourites (multi-select bulk unfavourite, size-band filtering, three-way snapshot cleanup), and export the list as tab-separated txt — plus session management: edit and resend any user message, undo a whole turn, with every file the assistant touched snapshotted automatically and restored on rollback — plus one-click continuation: distil a long conversation into a compact five-section brief (current goal, full todo, latest artefact progress, artefact/log paths, next steps; old artefacts are paths only), inheriting its preset by default or picking any preset from a dropdown after unticking — plus an Ungrouped health check: a read-only diagnosis, a dry-run-first one-click cleanup, and a boot-time self-check that warns in the log. Additive slot extensions that edit no official file, sweep orphan projection-cache records that directory scans cannot see, and hide the bucket by default.
